<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula: DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X) / 2. For C8H15O, C=8, H=15, N=0, X=0. DBE = (2*8 + 2 - 15) / 2 = (18 - 15) / 2 = 3/2 = 1.5, which rounds to the nearest whole number 2 (representing one ring plus one double bond).</thought>
<final_answer>2</final_answer>
